scenes.line1: How do apps open to the right screen?
scenes.say: Ever tapped a notification and landed on the exact screen you needed? Let's see how deep linking makes that work in React Native.

scenes.label: DeepLink
scenes.sub: Lets your app open screens from URLs or notifications.
scenes.say: Deep linking means your app can jump straight to a screen from a web link or a push notification.
First, you set up which URLs your app should handle. Then, you map those URLs to screens, grab any parameters, and make sure navigation state matches the link.
Here's a real config. This setup lets my app open a user profile screen directly from a link with a user ID.

scenes.question: What if you skip navigation state sync?
scenes.right: You risk landing on the wrong screen or losing context when opening from a link.
scenes.say: Don't forget—if you skip syncing navigation state, your app might open to the wrong place or lose the user's spot. That's a classic interview pitfall.
